name: Shikouin Kasumi
source:
A schoolgirl often seen together with [url=/c473]Tsutomu[/url]. She wears glasses to negate her ability to see one's true feelings, and she is fond of purchasing tea leaves from [url=/c13713]Hikari[/url]’s shop.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wind:_A_Breath_of_Heart]Wikipedia[/url]]
